statement: Fill the area enclosed by objects around a picked internal point using a pattern, solid color or gradient, applying island detection and a gap tolerance to find the boundary.
superiority: Boundary detection is exact with repair preview.

acceptance.sketch: Pick inside a 10x10 square with a circle hole r=2: hatch region area = 100 - pi*4 for Normal island style; gap tolerance 0.05 closes a 0.04 gap.

notes: Verified against help page "HATCH (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-006BE8D3-0731-47BA-A7CF-1B50282CD108 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Define a hatch boundary by selecting objects that enclose an area; interior objects are not detected automatically and must be selected to be treated according to the island detection style.

source.ref: Add: Select Objects (Hatch and Gradient dialog box)

acceptance.sketch: Select polyline: hatch fills its interior ignoring inner objects.

notes: Verified against help page "Common Options (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)". Corrected: Original said island detection is off; help says interior objects are not auto-detected with Select Objects but the current island style still applies to those selected. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-27C104F2-B687-4025-B50B-A58E37329832 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide predefined hatch patterns (ANSI, ISO and others from the standard PAT files), user-defined patterns based on the current linetype, and custom patterns from added PAT files, with a preview palette for choosing patterns.

source.ref: Hatch Tab (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)

superiority: Pattern definitions are open PAT and exact line families; custom patterns importable.

acceptance.sketch: ISO pattern ANSI31 draws 45 degree lines at spacing scale*3.175 mm; user-defined spacing 5 angle 30 gives lines at 5 spacing.

notes: Verified against help page "Hatch Tab (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-DD07390A-8627-434B-B4F5-82168B7379B2 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F943F802-18F1-423C-B2B8-42C797CDF5E2 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Set hatch pattern angle and scale, scale relative to paper space in a layout, double (cross) lines and spacing for user-defined patterns, and an ISO pen width multiplier for ISO predefined patterns.

acceptance.sketch: Scale 2 doubles spacing; angle 45 rotates; relative-to-paper-space keeps paper spacing when viewport scale changes.

notes: Verified against help page "Hatch Tab (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)". Corrected: Double applies to user-defined patterns only and ISO pen width to ISO predefined patterns only. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B3FF6503-8FFB-4F1A-A603-52A6408F0D66 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers HatchScale; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Set the hatch origin by picking a point, by one of four boundary-extent corners or the extents center, by reverting to the current default origin, and store a new origin as the default.

acceptance.sketch: Origin at (1,1): pattern lines positioned relative to that point; patterns repeat across.

notes: Verified against help page "Hatch Tab (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)". statement: Make hatches associative so they update when their boundary objects change, with non-associative hatches left unchanged, and control whether several closed boundaries yield one hatch or separate hatches.

notes: Verified against help page "Common Options (Hatch and Gradient Dialog Box)". statement: Provide Normal, Outer and Ignore island detection styles that determine how boundaries nested inside the outer boundary are filled.

statement: Support one-color (tint or shade) and two-color gradient fills in nine patterns (linear, cylindrical, inverted cylindrical, spherical, hemispherical, curved and their inverted forms), with gradient angle and a centered or shifted orientation.

statement: Cap the number of hatch lines generated by one hatch operation (default 100000, range 100 to 10,000,000) so dense patterns stay responsive, and switch overly sparse patterns to solid fill unless legacy behavior is chosen via HPMAXAREAS.
